'''Charyl Ann Perry''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 60 FL from Pearland, Tx. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" />

Her Decipher profile lists her as Charyl Perry, Flight Leader Red 60 in the Dantooine region, from Pearland, TX. She grew up in Columbus, Ohio, moved to the Houston area in 1997, and helped organize Houston players through the Rebel Gamer of Texas website and newslist.<ref name="decsq-prof">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/perrycharyl.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Red 60 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010212100140/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/perrycharyl.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
I was born and raised in the heart of Corellia (Columbus, OH). I've been a Star Wars fan since 1977!

In 1997, I moved to Southeast Dantooine (Houston, TX), where I became Flight Leader Red 60.

Many people are surprised to see a female SW player.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>
